heard: Foreman Wag Dodge survived a raging wildfire by starting his own. The fire was reported on August 5, 1949. Fifteen smokejumpers arrived to combat the blaze. High winds suddenly expanded the fire and cut their root. Dodge stepped into his burn area and lay down quietly. His fleeing crew ran past him and were overtaken by flames. Foreman Wag Dodge survived a raging wildfire by starting his own.
